Message:
ibmvnic: avoid memset null scrq msgs

scrq->msgs could be NULL during device reset, causing Linux to crash.
So, check before memset scrq->msgs.

Fixes: c8b2ad0a4a901 ("ibmvnic: Sanitize entire SCRQ buffer on reset")
